# `aitbc exchange create-pair`

Create a new trading pair on a registered exchange with precision and minimum order size.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange create-pair [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--base-asset` | text | — | yes | Base asset symbol (e.g., AITBC) |
| `--quote-asset` | text | — | yes | Quote asset symbol (e.g., ETH) |
| `--exchange` | text | — | yes | Exchange name |
| `--min-order-size` | float | `0.001` | no | Minimum order size |
| `--price-precision` | integer | `8` | no | Price precision |
| `--quantity-precision` | integer | `8` | no | Quantity precision |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange create-pair --base-asset <base_asset> --quote-asset <quote_asset> --exchange <exchange>
```
